summary: Iter61 backend + frontend regression — AKKI Solve Wave 1 (4-phase engine, 12 clusters, restart/abandon, list/sort) + Walk-in context hint + /admin/auth/events. 12/12 backend pytest pass against live LLM (Sonnet) and live MongoDB. Frontend: /app/solve picker → IntentView → SessionView → Surface→Depth phase advance verified end-to-end in browser with real LLM responses (~100s total).

minor.issue: Endpoint path is /api/admin/auth/events (not /api/admin/auth-events as described in the review request prose). Frontend route /admin/auth-events is correct; backend just lives at /api/admin/auth/events. No bug — flagging for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: solve_engine.py is clean — 4-phase state machine is straight-line, idempotent appends, persists turns on every step. _generate_phase_response correctly switches tier=deep only when phase==synthesis AND session.pro_tier; other phases stay on Sonnet so synthesis is the only deep slot consumed.
solve_clusters_seed.py seeder is idempotent (find_one then insert if missing) — operator MongoDB edits survive a redeploy as documented.

AppSolve.jsx properly surfaces all required testids (solve-cluster-grid, solve-cluster-{id}, solve-intent-card/use-example/pro-toggle/start, solve-session/turns/composer/input/send, solve-phase-stepper, solve-completed-banner, solve-resume-list/btn/restart-btn). Phase stepper renders all 4 phases, click→intent→session navigation works.
restart_session reuses start_session's primer path — clean DRY.
Pro tier path in solve_engine.py:401 uses call_llm_with_tier with surface='solve' — correctly isolated from decks/brief budgets per llm_tier_quota DEFAULT_QUOTAS['solve']=4.

Note (not blocking): list_my_sessions projection at solve_engine.py:139-144 is fine but could include `synthesis`/`lockin` body counts if the picker ever wants to show 'completed with diagnosis' badges in resume list. Wave 2 concern.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Solve module (picker→intent→session→phase advance verified). Admin auth-events dashboard render not visually verified due to second-login timeout in same session — API verified via backend tests.
